paragraphs.text: Kethis , also known as the Hidden Hand , is an elven advisor on the plane of Fiora .
“By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end.”

Kethis is a character that was introduced in Core Set 2020 . Kethis is an elf advisor from the plane of Fiora , a world known for its intricate political machinations. He is shown wearing elaborate robes and a headpiece. He appears to be left-handed.
